$comment: What the next release is (G36.19), read by release.yml into the signed release.json. 'version' is the release this kind is for: any other tag is normal. kind: normal | mandatory (it must be installed before RedGiant is used again) | breaking (a clean install: backup, uninstall, install, restore; never a differential update). minVersion: only versions below it are concerned (null: every older one). note: why, in a sentence, it and en (needed unless normal). requiredBelow / cleanInstallBelow: carried bounds; release-info.mjs folds this file's own mandatory or breaking version into them for every later tag, so keep them when you change version and kind.
